newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas shrs end off in shallow, range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Caracas shrs end off in shallow, range-bound trade.

text.p: Share prices on the Caracas Stock Exchange closed marginally lower in shallow, range-bound trade which again lacked the presence of foreign investors, brokers said.
According to preliminary figures from the exchange, the market's 19-share index slipped 0.35 percent to 9,257.78, as 21 stocks fell, 12 rose and 10 closed flat.
Brokers said foreign investors were distracted by losses on Wall Street, while many locals were taking summer vacations. The market will be closed Monday for a bank holiday.
"The market continues the trend of the week -- fairly quiet and relatively stable," said Vencred broker Geronimo Paolini, who said this trend would likely continue "at least for another month."
A total of 902 trades wee registered for 4.977 billion bolivars ($10 million).
Among leading stocks benchmark Electricidad de Caracas fell 0.35 bolivar to 812.75 bolivars and telephone company CANTV fell 24.00 bolivars to 3,001.00 bolivars.
